/-- Rule `i` is the first role rule whose pattern matches `sub`
(`match_role`: "First match wins"). -/
def FirstMatch (p : OidcProvider) (sub : List U8) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : i < p.role_rules.val.length,
    (∀ j (hj : j < i), Glob (p.role_rules.val[j]).pattern.val sub false) ∧
    Glob (p.role_rules.val[i]).pattern.val sub true

/-- [nora_kernel::validate_claims]:
    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 255:0-277:1
    Visibility: public -/
def validate_claims
  (provider : OidcProvider) (claims : Claims) :
  Result (core.result.Result OidcIdentity Error)
  := do
  match claims.iat with
  | none =>
    let subject ←
      match claims.sub with
      | none => ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U8)
      | some s => alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 s
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref subject
    let o ← match_role provider s
    match o with
    | none => ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NoRoleRule)
    | some x =>
      let (role, rule_scope) := x
      let v ←
        alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone (core.clone.CloneallocvecVec
          core.clone.CloneU8) provider.namespace_scope
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok
        {
          subject,
          role,
          namespace_scope := v,
          rule_namespace_scope := rule_scope,
          namespace_scope_enforcement := provider.namespace_scope_enforcement
        })
  | some iat =>
    match claims.exp with
    | none =>
      let subject ←
        match claims.sub with
        | none => ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U8)
        | some s => alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 s
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref subject
      let o ← match_role provider s
      match o with
      | none => ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NoRoleRule)
      | some x =>
        let (role, rule_scope) := x
        let v ←
          alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone (core.clone.CloneallocvecVec
            core.clone.CloneU8) provider.namespace_scope
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok
          {
            subject,
            role,
            namespace_scope := v,
            rule_namespace_scope := rule_scope,
            namespace_scope_enforcement := provider.namespace_scope_enforcement
          })
    | some exp =>
      let lifetime ← lift (core.num.U64.saturating_sub exp iat)
      if lifetime > provider.max_token_lifetime_secs
      then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.TokenLifetime)
      else
        let subject ←
          match claims.sub with
          | none => ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U8)
          | some s => alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 s
        let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref subject
        let o ← match_role provider s
        match o with
        | none => ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NoRoleRule)
        | some x =>
          let (role, rule_scope) := x
          let v ←
            alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone (core.clone.CloneallocvecVec
              core.clone.CloneU8) provider.namespace_scope
          ok (core.result.Result.Ok
            {
              subject,
              role,
              namespace_scope := v,
              rule_namespace_scope := rule_scope,
              namespace_scope_enforcement :=
                provider.namespace_scope_enforcement
            })

theorem usize_succ {i w : Usize} (hb : i.val < Usize.max) (h : i + 1#usize = ok w) :
    w.val = i.val + 1 := by
  have hs : (i + 1#usize) ⦃ z => z.val = i.val + 1 ⦄ := by
    have := UScalar.add_spec (x := i) (y := 1#usize) (by scalar_tac)
    exact WP.spec_mono this (fun z hz => by simpa using hz)
  exact post_of_ok (P := fun z : Usize => z.val = i.val + 1) hs h

theorem slice_index_ok {α} {a : Slice α} {i : Usize} {x : α} (h : a.index_usize i = ok x) :
    a.val[i.val]? = some x := by
  unfold Slice.index_usize at h
  split at h
  · simp at h
  · rename_i heq; simp at h; subst h; simpa using heq

theorem bytes_eq_true (a b : Slice U8) (h : bytes_eq a b = ok true) : a.val = b.val := by
  unfold bytes_eq at h
  simp only at h
  split at h
  · simp at h
  · rename_i hlen
    have hl : a.val.length = b.val.length := by simp at hlen; scalar_tac
    refine loop_ok (bytes_eq_loop.body a b)
      (fun i => i.val ≤ a.val.length ∧ ∀ k < i.val, a.val[k]? = b.val[k]?)
      (fun y => y = true → a.val = b.val) (fun i => a.val.length - i.val) ?_ 0#usize true ⟨by simp, by simp⟩ h rfl
    rintro i r ⟨hi, hk⟩ hb
    unfold bytes_eq_loop.body at hb
    i5h_invert hb
    · simp
    · rename_i hlt x hx y hy hne w hw
      have hlt' : i.val < a.val.length := by scalar_tac
      have hw' := usize_succ (by scalar_tac) hw
      have hxy : x = y := by simp at hne; scalar_tac
      have ha := slice_index_ok hx
      have hb := slice_index_ok hy
      refine ⟨⟨by omega, fun k hk' => ?_⟩, by omega⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 (hw' ▸ hk') with h1 | h1
      · exact hk k h1
      · subst h1; rw [ha, hb, hxy]
    · rename_i hge
      intro _
      have : a.val.length ≤ i.val := by scalar_tac
      apply List.ext_getElem? 
      intro k
      by_cases hk' : k < i.val
      · exact hk k hk'
      · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega), List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]

theorem vec_index_ok {α} {a : alloc.vec.Vec α} {i : Usize} {x : α}

  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize at h
  split at h
  · simp at h
  · rename_i heq; simp at h; subst h; simpa using heq

def RoleOk (p : OidcProvider) (s : Slice U8) : Prop :=
  ∃ i, ∃ hi : i < p.role_rules.val.length,
    (∀ j < i, ∀ r, p.role_rules.val[j]? = some r → glob_match (alloc.vec.Vec.deref r.pattern) s = ok false) ∧

theorem lit_eq {v : alloc.vec.Vec U8} {n : Usize} {l : List U8} {hl} {w : Slice U8} {b : Bool}

    (hb : b = true) : v.val = l := by

  have := bytes_eq_true _ _ he
  simp [lift] at hw; subst hw
  simpa [alloc.vec.Vec.deref, alloc.vec.Vec.val, array_to_slice_val] using this

theorem roleok_of {p : OidcProvider} {s : Slice U8} {i : Usize} {rule : OidcRoleRule} {b : Bool}
    (hlt : i.val < p.role_rules.val.length) (hrule : p.role_rules.val[i.val]? = some rule)
    (hk : ∀ j < i.val, ∀ r, p.role_rules.val[j]? = some r → glob_match (alloc.vec.Vec.deref r.pattern) s = ok false)
    (hg : glob_match (alloc.vec.Vec.deref rule.pattern) s = ok b) (hb : b = true)
    (hrole : rule.role.val = [119#u8, 114#u8, 105#u8, 116#u8, 101#u8] ∨

  · rename_i hlt rule hidx b hg hbt _ _ _ _ _ w hw b1 hbe hb1 _ _ _ _ _

    ∃ sv : alloc.vec.Vec U8, sv.val = subject c ∧ ∃ sc,
      match_role_loop p (alloc.vec.Vec.deref sv) 0#usize = ok (some (id.role, sc)) := by

  i5h_invert h
  all_goals
    rename_i w hsub _ x hm

    obtain ⟨v, _, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    simp only [ok.injEq, core.result.Result.Ok.injEq] at h; subst h

    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch] at h

    Glob r.val sub b := by
  subst hsv
  refine ⟨r.property, sv.property, ?_⟩
  simpa [alloc.vec.Vec.deref, alloc.vec.Vec.val, Slice.val_from] using h

    nats v.val = lit "write" := by

    nats v.val = lit "admin" := by

theorem bytes_eq_loop_spec (left right : Slice U8)
    (hlen : left.val.length = right.val.length) (index : Usize)
    (hbound : index.val ≤ left.val.length)
    (hprefix : ∀ pos, pos < index.val → left.val[pos]? = right.val[pos]?) :

    (measure := fun current : Usize => left.val.length - current.val)
    (inv := fun current => current.val ≤ left.val.length ∧
      ∀ pos, pos < current.val → left.val[pos]? = right.val[pos]?)
  · intro current hinv
    obtain ⟨hcurrent, hprevious⟩ := hinv
    unfold bytes_eq_loop.body
    step*
    all_goals try simp_all
    · refine ⟨by scalar_tac, ?_, by scalar_tac⟩
      intro pos hpos
      by_cases heq : pos = current.val
      · subst pos
        have hleft : current.val < left.val.length := by scalar_tac
        have hright : current.val < right.val.length := by omega
        simp only [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hleft, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hright,
          Option.some.injEq]
        scalar_tac
      · exact hprevious pos (by omega)
    · apply List.ext_getElem?
      intro pos
      by_cases hpos : pos < right.val.length
      · exact hprevious pos (by omega)
      · simp [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega : left.val.length ≤ pos),
          List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega : right.val.length ≤ pos)]
  · exact ⟨hbound, hprefix⟩

theorem bytes_eq_true (left right : Slice U8)
    (h : bytes_eq left right = ok true) : left.val = right.val := by
  unfold bytes_eq at h
  dsimp only at h
  split at h
  · simp at h
  · rename_i hlen
    have heq : left.val.length = right.val.length := by simpa using hlen
    exact post_of_ok (bytes_eq_loop_spec left right heq 0#usize (by simp) (by simp)) h rfl

def Granted (provider : OidcProvider) (sub : List U8) : Prop :=
  ∃ index, ∃ hindex : index < provider.role_rules.val.length,
    FirstMatch provider sub index ∧
      (nats (provider.role_rules.val[index]).role.val = lit "write" ∨
       nats (provider.role_rules.val[index]).role.val = lit "admin")

@[simp] theorem lit_write : lit "write" = [119, 114, 105, 116, 101] := by
  change lit (String.ofList ['w', 'r', 'i', 't', 'e']) = _
  simp only [lit, String.toUTF8_eq_toByteArray, String.toByteArray_ofList]
  simp [List.utf8Encode, String.utf8EncodeChar, ByteArray.toList, ByteArray.toList.loop,
    List.toByteArray, List.toByteArray.loop, ByteArray.size, ByteArray.get!]

@[simp] theorem lit_admin : lit "admin" = [97, 100, 109, 105, 110] := by
  change lit (String.ofList ['a', 'd', 'm', 'i', 'n']) = _
  simp only [lit, String.toUTF8_eq_toByteArray, String.toByteArray_ofList]
  simp [List.utf8Encode, String.utf8EncodeChar, ByteArray.toList, ByteArray.toList.loop,
    List.toByteArray, List.toByteArray.loop, ByteArray.size, ByteArray.get!]

theorem glob_of_ok (pattern : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (sub : Slice U8) (matched : Bool)
    (h : glob_match (alloc.vec.Vec.deref pattern) sub = ok matched) :
    Glob pattern.val sub.val matched := by
  refine ⟨pattern.property, sub.property, ?_⟩
  rw [show Slice.from pattern.val pattern.property = alloc.vec.Vec.deref pattern from
    Slice.ext _ _ rfl]
  simpa using h

theorem match_role_correct (provider : OidcProvider) (sub : Slice U8)
    (role : Role) (scope : Option (alloc.vec.Vec (alloc.vec.Vec U8)))
    (h : match_role provider sub = ok (some (role, scope)))
    (hwrite : role.can_write = ok true) : Granted provider sub.val := by
  have hloop := loop_ok (match_role_loop.body provider sub)
    (fun current => ∃ hbound : current.val ≤ provider.role_rules.val.length,
      ∀ pos (hpos : pos < current.val),
        Glob (provider.role_rules.val[pos]'(by omega)).pattern.val sub.val false)
    (fun result => ∀ found_role found_scope, result = some (found_role, found_scope) →
      found_role.can_write = ok true → Granted provider sub.val)
    (fun current => provider.role_rules.val.length - current.val) ?_
    0#usize (some (role, scope)) (by simp) h
  · exact hloop role scope rfl hwrite
  · intro current result hinv hbody
    obtain ⟨hcurrent, hprevious⟩ := hinv
    unfold match_role_loop.body at hbody
    dsimp only at hbody
    split at hbody
    · rename_i hlt
      have hindex : current.val < provider.role_rules.val.length := by scalar_tac
      simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index,
        eq_ok_of_spec (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec provider.role_rules current hindex),
        bind_ok] at hbody
      obtain ⟨matched, hglob, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hbody
      cases matched
      · simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hbody
        obtain ⟨next, hnext, hbody⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp hbody
        simp only [ok.injEq] at hbody
        subst result
        have hnextval := post_of_ok
          (Usize.add_spec (x := current) (y := 1#usize) (by scalar_tac)) hnext
        have hnextnat : next.val = current.val + 1 := by simpa using hnextval
        refine ⟨⟨by omega, ?_⟩, by omega⟩
        intro pos hpos
        by_cases heq : pos = current.val
        · subst pos
          exact glob_of_ok _ _ _ hglob
        · exact hprevious pos (by omega)
      · have hfirst : FirstMatch provider sub.val current.val :=
          ⟨hindex, hprevious, glob_of_ok _ _ _ hglob⟩
        simp only [↓reduceIte, lift, bind_ok] at hbody
        i5h_invert hbody
        all_goals simp_all only [lift, ok.injEq, Bool.not_eq_true]
        all_goals simp_all [Role.can_write, and_imp]
        all_goals try (refine ⟨current.val, hindex, hfirst, ?_⟩)
        all_goals subst_vars
        all_goals have hbytes := bytes_eq_true _ _ (by assumption)
        all_goals first
          | (left; simpa [nats, alloc.vec.Vec.deref, Array.to_slice, Array.make]
              using congrArg nats hbytes)
          | (right; simpa [nats, alloc.vec.Vec.deref, Array.to_slice, Array.make]
              using congrArg nats hbytes)
    · simp only [ok.injEq] at hbody
      subst result
      simp

theorem subject_of_ok (claims : Claims) (token_subject : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : (match claims.sub with
      | none => ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new U8)
      | some value => ok value) = ok token_subject) :
    token_subject.val = subject claims := by
  cases hsub : claims.sub <;> simp_all [subject, alloc.vec.Vec.new]
  subst token_subject
  rfl

theorem validate_claims_correct (provider : OidcProvider) (claims : Claims)
    (identity : OidcIdentity)
    (h : validate_claims provider claims = ok (.Ok identity))
    (hwrite : identity.role.can_write = ok true) : Granted provider (subject claims) := by
  unfold validate_claims at h
  i5h_invert h
  all_goals simp_all only [u8vec_clone]
  all_goals
    rename_i token_subject unused_option role_scope hsub hmatch
    rcases role_scope with ⟨found_role, found_scope⟩
    change (do
      let namespaces ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone
        (core.clone.CloneallocvecVec core.clone.CloneU8) provider.namespace_scope
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok (OidcIdentity.mk token_subject found_role namespaces found_scope
        provider.namespace_scope_enforcement) : core.result.Result OidcIdentity Error)) =
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok identity) at h
    obtain ⟨namespaces, hclone, hidentity⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
    simp only [ok.injEq, core.result.Result.Ok.injEq] at hidentity
    subst identity
    have hgranted := match_role_correct provider (alloc.vec.Vec.deref token_subject)
      found_role found_scope hmatch hwrite
    simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.deref, Slice.from_val, subject_of_ok claims token_subject hsub]
      using hgranted

theorem read_only_cannot_write (p : OidcProvider) (c : Claims) (r : Request) (x : Reply)
    (h : transition p c r = ok (.Ok x)) (hw : isWrite r.method) :
    ∃ i, ∃ hi : i < p.role_rules.val.length, FirstMatch p (subject c) i ∧
      (nats (p.role_rules.val[i]).role.val = lit "write" ∨
       nats (p.role_rules.val[i]).role.val = lit "admin") := by
  unfold transition at h
  obtain ⟨validation, hvalidation, hrun⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.mp h
  cases validation with
  | Err error =>
    simp [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual] at hrun
  | Ok identity =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, bind_ok] at hrun
    have hwrite : identity.role.can_write = ok true := by
      cases hrole : identity.role with
      | Write => rfl
      | Admin => rfl
      | Read =>
        cases hmethod : r.method <;> simp_all [isWrite, Role.can_write]
    exact validate_claims_correct p c identity hvalidation hwrite
